value.signature: fn disclosure_profile (& self , carrier : & publication :: disclosures :: Disclosure) -> bool

review.body: { carrier . numeric == self . numeric && carrier . frames . iter () . all (| f | { f . realization == realization () && Self :: accepted_procedure (& f . procedure . solve) && f . procedure . arithmetic == premise_limits () && f . procedure . maximum_products == 10_000_u64 }) }
review.item_premise: This operation handles the publicly disclosed root or its synthetic verifier premise and records its full public arguments and result.
